tvs.title-bl-seo: Is the price of permanent makeup justified?
tvs.text-bl-seo: Naturally, when you see the cost of a cosmetic tattoo, you might wonder: “Why this price?” You have probably already come across artists who charge several times less, or even significantly more. The price of a tattoo procedure covers a whole range of essential costs that the studio has to invest every month in order to offer quality services. Here is how the cost of permanent makeup is made up.
tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
What the price of a micropigmentation procedure includes

In any business, the final price of a product or service may include a number of costs of various kinds. So whenever a consumable is used for you during a procedure, keep in mind that we bought it to have it on hand for you and provided it at no extra charge. So what exactly is included in the price?

Quality of the result

Of course, what matters most to every client is the quality of the result and the safety of their health. A good result reflects the skilled work of a professional artist. This is where their experience comes in: understanding and assessing the procedure for a specific area and applying the right technique. Knowing how to do a tattoo is not enough. It is essential to understand which color type suits the makeup being applied and how it will look on a particular skin type. So it is important to be able to predict the result in advance, so that it turns out perfect. Clearly, all of this comes with experience.
And experience is built not only through constant practice, but also through continuous professional development: attending masterclasses and industry events, studying ever more advanced materials and equipment, and so on. Development takes investment and money, and the artist expects it to pay off in the future. That is why, above all, you are paying to be sure of a safe, effective, high-quality result.

The cost of consumables

All consumables, purchased individually for each client, are included in the price of permanent makeup. These include not only pigments and single-use needles, but also dry and wet wipes, cotton swabs and cotton pads, disposable caps and shoe covers, masks, sheets, disinfectants and many other items. The price also covers the extras clients can enjoy at the studio: hygiene products, sweets and more.

The cost of equipment

High-quality professional equipment that won't let you down mid-procedure usually costs a great deal of money. Part of the cost of recouping it is also included in the price of the tattoo.

Studio maintenance costs

To make sure you feel comfortable at our studio, we have invested significant sums in fitting it out. The price of a micropigmentation procedure covers not only the costs we have already incurred, but also those we have to cover every month, such as utility bills.

Staff salaries

We want not only our clients to be happy with the result, but also our team to be happy with their work. That is why we pay every employee a competitive, decent salary. In fact, this is also what motivates us to deliver the quality of service you expect.

Why are prices much lower at other studios?

Obviously, a lower price means the artist has saved money on certain materials. This is quite risky, because cutting corners on the quality of consumables, disinfection equipment and products, and micropigmentation equipment can lower the level of safety for your health. It can also leave you with a terrible tattoo that will disappoint you, to say the least. Low prices for micropigmentation are often charged by beginner artists who don't yet have enough experience. It is up to you to decide whether you are willing to entrust your face to a novice, or whether it is worth paying more for this service and being 100% sure of the perfect result you wanted.

Does a higher price mean a better result?

While a low price for permanent makeup signals cost-cutting, an excessively high price indicates that the studio owner simply wants to earn more. That is the whole secret.

Don't skimp on your tattoo.
But don't overpay either: protect your budget. Trust only professional artists who can make your dream come true with quality work that never puts your health or beauty at risk.
